calc: hard=sqft*per_sqft(tier); shell=(hard-foundation)*0.45; finishes=(hard-foundation)*0.55; soft=hard*soft_pct; build_subtotal=demo+hard+site_pool+seawall+soft; contingency=build_subtotal*contingency_pct; total=land+closing+build_subtotal+contingency+carrying. Low/likely/high = all inputs at low/mid/high tier.

line_items.label: Land (list price, MLS 84692771)
line_items.note: List price; negotiated price may differ.

line_items.label: Buyer closing costs (cash)
line_items.note: Cash purchase ~1-2% of price; 2-5% if financed.

line_items.label: Demolition of existing house
line_items.note: $6-10/sf demolition (FL 2025). Existing house sq ft assumed 4,000 - needs verification from MLS/property appraiser; asbestos/permit extras not included.

line_items.label: Pile foundation (V-zone, engineered piles)
line_items.note: Pineland cites $40k-$120k for a full coastal pile foundation (mid is midpoint). Likely low for a 6,000 sf Gulf-front luxury home with deep augered/driven piles and grade beams; Renick notes pilings push Gulf-front builds to $600+/sf. Needs geotech + structural quote.

line_items.label: Shell: ICF / reinforced CMU structure, roof, impact glazing, MEP rough-in
line_items.note: Total hard cost = sq ft x $/sf (low $600 = Sennes 'LBK starts at $600/sf' and Renick '$600+ with pilings'; mid $800 and high $1,000 from Tri-Town FL luxury $400-$800+, ultra-custom $1,000+). 45/55 shell/finish split is a modeling assumption - needs verification.

line_items.label: Interior finishes, cabinetry, systems, elevator
line_items.note: See shell note; split is an assumption.

line_items.label: Site work, driveway/landscape, pool
line_items.note: Driveway+landscaping $10k-$50k+ (Homes by Strong); pools/outdoor kitchens $30k-$150k+ each (Tri-Town). Elevated pool in V zone may cost more - needs verification.

line_items.label: Seawall / coastal armoring
line_items.note: Beach (not canal) frontage: armoring seaward of CCCL is generally restricted; set to $0. If a seawall/bulkhead exists or is permitted, Renick cites $500-$1,200 per linear foot. Needs verification by survey.

line_items.label: Soft costs: architect, structural/geotech, surveys, elevation certificate, CCCL/FDEP + Town of LBK permits, impact fees
line_items.note: 10/12.5/15% of hard cost is an industry rule of thumb, NOT sourced. Get architect fee proposal, FDEP CCCL permit fee schedule, Town of Longboat Key and Manatee County impact fee schedules.

line_items.label: Contingency
line_items.note: Applied to demolition+construction+site+soft. % is a user parameter.

line_items.label: Carrying costs during design+build (property tax only)
line_items.note: Renick: LBK (Manatee) ~13.5 mills on assessed value, no homestead. $5.6M x 1.35% = ~$75,600/yr x 2/2.5/3 yr (duration assumed). Excludes builder's risk, liability, and financing interest - needs verification.

drivers: Finish tier $/sf: each $100/sf on 6,000 sf = $600k before soft costs/contingency.
V-zone engineering: pile depth/count (geotech), breakaway walls, elevation to BFE + freeboard, impact envelope.
Schedule: CCCL/FDEP permitting and build duration drive carrying costs (~$75.6k/yr tax alone).
Post-Helene/Milton contractor demand on barrier islands (Renick).
